quoteLine: Every job is quoted individually after a free consultation.

audit.name: The Keystroke Audit
audit.what: We watch one of your processes from start to finish, count every keystroke in it, and tell you what it costs and what to fix.

steps.title: We watch one process.
steps.text: Someone does the job once, the usual way, while we record it.

steps.title: We count it.
steps.text: Every keystroke in it, and how often it happens in a year.

steps.title: You get a report and a fixed quote.
steps.text: What it costs you, what to fix first, and what the fix would cost.

audit.next: After the audit we quote the build, inside one of three ranges.
includes: The count and its cost in hours
A ranked list of what to fix
A scoped quote for the first build

items.name: A reporting pack that builds itself
Job costing you can read while the job is running
One entry that writes every system
Systems that keep each other in step
A tool built for how the business runs
One identity and one set of documents

estimates.unit: hours a year lost to re-entry

savers.label: Foundation pricing
savers.foundationNote: Foundation pricing is our launch rate for early clients.
savers.what: We keep what we built running, fix it when something changes, and improve it every month.
includes: Monitoring and repair of everything we built
The monthly reporting pack, produced and checked

tiers.name: Watch
tiers.suits: One or two automations that need to keep running.

tiers.name: Run
tiers.suits: Several systems, with regular changes each month.

tiers.name: Own
tiers.suits: We run and improve your admin systems as an ongoing job.

savers.scope: Savers covers what we built for you. General IT support is not included, but it can be added to a plan as scheduled work.

priceList.currency: All prices are in Australian dollars.
priceList.rest: Everything else is quoted on hours and given to you as a fixed total before work starts.

care.title: Website care
care.what: Three monthly plans for websites we built. Every plan includes hosting and general maintenance. The upper two add hours of work each month.

tiers.name: Hosting and maintenance
tiers.suits: Hosting and general maintenance for a site we built.

tiers.name: Plus 2 hours
tiers.suits: Hosting and maintenance, with hours for blogs, articles or general website updates.

tiers.name: Plus 10 hours
tiers.suits: Hosting and maintenance, with hours for any change, edit or request, including blogs and articles.

websites.title: Website builds
websites.what: Two fixed-price builds. The difference is who runs the site afterwards: us, or you.

facts.label: How it is built
facts.text: A new site, built in code by Keystroke.

facts.label: Hosting
facts.text: On a website care plan, or you deploy the code yourself.

facts.label: Ongoing costs
facts.text: A website care plan from $89 a month, or nothing if you host it yourself.

facts.label: Who makes changes
facts.text: We do, through a website care plan.

facts.label: Best for
facts.text: A business that wants its site run for it.

facts.label: How it is built
facts.text: In WordPress, with the Elementor page builder.

facts.label: Hosting
facts.text: On hosting you own. We can set it up.

facts.label: Ongoing costs
facts.text: You pay for hosting, the domain and any plugin and theme subscriptions directly.

facts.label: Who makes changes
facts.text: You do, after one hour of training. We do on request.

facts.label: Best for
facts.text: A business that wants to edit its own pages.

after: When a site built in code is delivered, you choose one of two paths. Take a website care plan, and we host and maintain it. Or take the code and host it yourself, and our part ends at handover.
On the WordPress build, every account and licence is held in your name. We set them up on request, and never pay for them on your behalf.

audits.title: Audits
audits.what: Two ways to start. One is free and quick. The other is fixed price and counts a whole process.

items.name: Initial audit
items.includes: A quick overview only. It is not an in-depth audit.

items.name: The Keystroke Audit
